name: forge
description: Drives a project from scope through architecture into development, generating project skills and accumulating portable lessons across every project it touches.

lessons_repo.title: Lesson library repository
lessons_repo.description: GitHub repo (owner/name) or git URL that holds your Forge lesson library. Leave empty to keep lessons on this machine only. Run /forge:setup to clone or create it.

lessons_path.title: Local clone of the lesson library
lessons_path.description: Where the lesson library is cloned on this machine, e.g. ~/dev/forge-lessons. /forge:setup clones it here.
